reasoning_content:
Backend works. Now start frontend dev server and verify via Traefik. The run-dev recipe does a lot. Let's set up the traefik dynamic config and run frontend dev.

Let me generate the dev-services.yaml and start the frontend. Actually the guide's quick start is `just run-dev` which runs backend via bacon + frontend. But we already have backend running manually. Let me verify frontend builds/previews and the full stack via traefik.

Let me start the frontend dev server.

action.command: cd /workspace && sed -e 's|${APP_HOST}|localhost|g' -e 's|${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}|web|g' .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml.tmpl > .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml && cat .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml && docker logs workspace-reverse-proxy-1 2>&1 | tail -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && sed -e 's|${APP_HOST}|localhost|g' -e 's|${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}|web|g' .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml.tmpl > .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml && cat .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml && docker logs workspace-reverse-proxy-1 2>&1 | tail -5", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Render traefik dev services config"}
